title: Koya, Qizqapan & Sulaymaniyah
full_text:
Early departure to drive to Koya, with a short tea break at the historical Koya Fort.
Stop at Zarzi Village to visit Qizqapan, an archaeological rock relief from the Medes period.
The village itself also caves with the footage of the neanderthal and over 13000 years of farminghistory.
Arrival in Sulaymaniyah, explore the city’s Bazaar and visit the Red Museum (Amna Suraka).
Late Lunch at a traditional Kurdish restaurant.
Check-in to the hotel or optional overnight stay at Maryam Adhra Monastery, offering a unique cultural experience.
Evening walk along Saholaka Street to enjoy vibrant nightlife, street food, and coffee/tea stalls.
